# Feature table

<!-- Generated by `cbp features --doc`. Do not edit by hand. -->

One row per **approved** transaction (only approved charges can be disputed). Every
feature is point-in-time: it uses the transaction itself and events strictly before its
`created_at`. Prior disputes count by **filing** date, not by the date of the disputed
charge. Velocity counts include declined attempts.

Label columns (`disputed`, `reason_code`, `dispute_category`, `label_mature`) sit
alongside the features and must never be used as inputs. `label_mature` is false while
the dispute window is still open, so a negative label there may yet turn positive.

| # | Feature | Group | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `amount_usd` | transaction | numeric | Charge amount in dollars. |
| 2 | `is_initial` | transaction | flag | First charge of a subscription. |
| 3 | `is_renewal` | transaction | flag | Merchant-initiated recurring charge (card on file). |
| 4 | `is_one_off` | transaction | flag | Customer-initiated purchase outside a subscription. |
| 5 | `is_mastercard` | transaction | flag | Card network is Mastercard (vs. Visa). |
| 6 | `attempt` | transaction | count | Authorization attempt number for this charge; 2+ means it is a retry after a soft decline. |
| 7 | `account_age_days` | account | numeric | Days between account creation and the charge. |
| 8 | `email_disposable` | account | flag | Signed up with a disposable email domain. |
| 9 | `email_freemail` | account | flag | Signed up with a free webmail domain (baseline: corporate). |
| 10 | `ip_missing` | geo | flag | No customer IP: merchant-initiated charge with no customer session. |
| 11 | `ip_bin_mismatch` | geo | flag | Customer IP country differs from the card's issuing (BIN) country. 0 when IP is missing. |
| 12 | `billing_bin_mismatch` | geo | flag | Account billing country differs from the card's issuing (BIN) country. |
| 13 | `attempts_1h` | velocity | count | Authorization attempts in the previous hour. |
| 14 | `attempts_24h` | velocity | count | Authorization attempts in the previous 24 hours. |
| 15 | `attempts_7d` | velocity | count | Authorization attempts in the previous 7 days. |
| 16 | `declines_24h` | velocity | count | Declined attempts in the previous 24 hours (card-testing signal). |
| 17 | `declines_30d` | velocity | count | Declined attempts in the previous 30 days. |
| 18 | `approved_usd_24h` | velocity | numeric | Dollars approved in the previous 24 hours (spend burst). |
| 19 | `days_since_prev_attempt` | velocity | numeric | Days since the customer's previous attempt; 365 if none. |
| 20 | `au_updates_90d` | card_on_file | count | Account-updater card reissues in the previous 90 days (the cardholder may believe the old card ended the subscription). |
| 21 | `customer_card_updates_90d` | card_on_file | count | Cards on file replaced by the customer in the previous 90 days. |
| 22 | `days_since_card_update` | card_on_file | numeric | Days since the card on file last changed (any source); 365 if never. |
| 23 | `plan_is_annual` | subscription | flag | Charge belongs to an annual plan. |
| 24 | `subscription_age_days` | subscription | numeric | Days since the subscription started. |
| 25 | `prior_approved_renewals` | subscription | count | Renewals of this subscription that were approved before this charge. |
| 26 | `prior_subscription_declines` | subscription | count | Declined attempts on this subscription before this charge (retry history). |
| 27 | `charged_after_cancel_request` | subscription | flag | The customer had already asked to cancel this subscription: a legitimate 'cancelled recurring' dispute waiting to happen. |
| 28 | `prior_disputes` | prior_disputes | count | Disputes the customer filed before this charge. |
| 29 | `prior_fraud_disputes` | prior_disputes | count | Of those, disputes in the fraud category (Visa 10.4, Mastercard 4837). |
| 30 | `days_since_last_dispute` | prior_disputes | numeric | Days since the customer last filed a dispute; 365 if never. |
